what: The second false-alarm control, a different shape: typing rather than clicking, and one clause whose evidence is a line of text where rows used to be.

AC-1.why: Two beats type a word into the box and the queue narrows to a single row while the box fills; no button is pressed anywhere in the take.

AC-2.why: Typing refund leaves the 'No tickets match this filter.' line in place of the rows, which is the clause verbatim on screen.
